cards.text: Judah's King Ahaziah is dead. His mother, Athaliah, sees that her son is gone. And friend, what she does next is NOT a sympathy card.

cards.question: Athaliah sees that her son Ahaziah is dead. What does she set out to do?

answers.text: Hand the throne to a grandson

cards.text: But one woman makes a move. Jehoshabeath, King Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's sister, steals Ahaziah's son Joash right out from among the king's sons who are being murdered.
She puts Joash and his nurse in a bedroom and hides him so Athaliah can't kill him. Here's the kicker: Jehoshabeath is the wife of Jehoiada the priest.

cards.question: Jehoshabeath is married to Jehoiada the priest. So where does Joash stay hidden with them?
Joash stays hidden in the house of God for ___ years while Athaliah rules the land.

cards.text: Friend, I did years in a junk drawer, and nobody was even LOOKING for me. But in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthens himself and makes a covenant with five commanders of hundreds.

cards.question: Jehoiada is a priest, and Joash is hidden in the house of God. The commanders go all through Judah and gather the ___ from every city, along with the heads of Israel's families.

cards.text: Everybody comes to Jerusalem, and the whole assembly makes a covenant with the king in the house of God. Then Jehoiada makes the big reveal: “Behold, the king’s son!”

cards.question: Jehoiada says the king's son must reign. Why?

answers.text: The LORD promised it to David's line
The army has already chosen him
Athaliah once named him her heir

cards.text: Then Jehoiada lays out the plan. The priests and Levites coming on duty that Sabbath split into thirds at the doors, the royal palace and the Foundation Gate, and everyone else waits in the courtyards.

cards.question: During the plan, Jehoiada lets all the people into the house of the LORD.

cards.text: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand and stay close to him wherever he goes. Friend, in the drawer my whole security team was ONE rubber band.

cards.question: With a king to guard, everyone follows Jehoiada's orders, and he sends the divisions going off duty home.
From the house of God, Jehoiada hands the commanders spears and shields that belonged to King ___.

cards.text: He stations the troops all around the king, by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north. Then Jehoiada and his sons bring out the king's son.

cards.question: Jehoiada and his sons bring out the king's son. What do they put on him?

cards.text: They present him with the Testimony, proclaim him king, anoint him and shout, “Long live the king!” From a hidden bedroom to a CROWN, friend, and I thought MY comeback from the drawer was something.
Athaliah hears the noise of the people running and cheering the king. So she goes out to them in the house of the LORD.

She looks, and there's the king standing by his pillar at the entrance, with officers, trumpets, singers leading the praises and the whole land rejoicing. Six years running the place, and NOBODY told her about the party.

cards.question: Athaliah sees the new king and the whole crowd celebrating. What does she do?

answers.text: Bows down before the new king

cards.text: She screams, “Treason, treason!” Then Jehoiada sends out the commanders: “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.”

cards.question: Jehoiada wants Athaliah put to death right there in the house of the LORD.

cards.text: They seize Athaliah as she reaches the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

cards.question: Jehoiada makes a covenant between himself, the king and the people that they will be the LORD's people.
After the covenant, all the people go to the temple of Baal. What do they do to it?

cards.text: They smash the altars and idols to pieces and kill Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.

cards.question: Jehoiada puts someone in charge of the house of the LORD. Who?

cards.text: These are the priests David appointed, and they offer burnt offerings to the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and song.

cards.question: Jehoiada leaves the gates of the house of the LORD open to anyone at all.

cards.text: Then Jehoiada takes the commanders, the nobles, the rulers and all the people of the land, and they bring the king down from the house of the LORD and into the royal palace through the Upper Gate.

cards.question: Inside the palace, they seat King Joash on the royal ___.
All the people of the land rejoice, and the city is ___.

cards.text: The city is quiet because Athaliah has been put to the sword. But hang on, friend, because Joash's story is just getting started.
